vadsrijk.npc.praat.akim_kaasguh.1: Cheese! Real guh cheese! Homemade! No touching. Buying is fine. Uh... later.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.akim_kaasguh.2: I'm a normal guh. Totally normal. I love cheese nibbles and... uh... NOT mice. Nope. Yuck, mice.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.akim_kaasguh.3: Why are you looking at me like that? I'm just wearing sunglasses. It's sunny. Indoors too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.akim_kaasguh.4: I work for nobody! Well, for my boss. And his boss. And his boss's boss... we'd rather not name that one.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_bord_z1.1: Three orders a day, no more, no less.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_bord_z2.1: Three orders a day, no more, no less.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_bord_z3.1: Three orders a day, no more, no less.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_bord_z4.2: Who's making something nice for someone else?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_bord_z4.3: Craft Tokens? You earn those here!

vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_bord_z5.3: Craft Tokens? You earn those here!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_brouw_z1.2: Don't touch the kettle, it's hot!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_brouw_z1.3: Why are the crystals turning gray?

vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_brouw_z3.3: Why are the crystals turning gray?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_hout_z1.2: A tree you hug grows faster.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_imker_z3.2: Bees are guhs with little wings, I always say.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_imker_z3.3: Watch out, that Mika Beekeeper sucks everything dry!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_kok_z1.1: Tasting is fine, snacking is not!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_kok_z1.2: A feast only tastes great with your whole party.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_kok_z1.3: Granny Trudy says: always add a pinch of chonk.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_mijn_z1.3: A helmet on your head is never a bad idea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_naai_z1.3: Fluff Cotton is the softest thing there is.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_naai_z2.3: Fluff Cotton is the softest thing there is.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_naai_z3.3: Fluff Cotton is the softest thing there is.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_pluk_z1.2: A Golden Clover? Then you're in luck!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_pluk_z1.3: Have a sniff of the Blob Clover.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_smid_z1.2: A good sword is like a cuddle: sturdy but sweet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_smid_z1.3: Got a boss core? Then make a Masterwork!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_smid_z2.2: A good sword is like a cuddle: sturdy but sweet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_smid_z2.3: Got a boss core? Then make a Masterwork!

vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_z1.2: The biggest fish always just gets away.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.amb_vis_z1.3: Someday I'll fish on the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bakker_bram.1: My shroom pie is famous all the way to the Drip Caves. Not that many folks live there, though.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bakker_bram.2: Kneading dough is good for your pawsies. And for your mood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bakker_bram.3: Smell that! That's freshly baked chonk.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bankier.1: Your Chonk Coins are safer here than in a vault. This IS a vault. Well, soon. The vault door is still being made.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bankier.2: A hundred bronze is one silver. A hundred silver is one gold. A thousand gold is one vacation.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bankier.3: Interest? Of course. We pay in cuddles.
Looking for a Snuggle Squad? Every squad looking for new members is pinned on my board.
Traveling together is cozier. And you really don't do the Star-Snuffing Tower alone.
Go ahead and pin up your own note. I've got plenty of thumbtacks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.bond_bord_saffraanpoo: Squads need members! Just look at my board.
You do the Star-Snuffing Tower with two or more. This is where you find the more.
A Snuggle Squad is a caravan that never splits up.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.boswachter_mos.1: The Sporewood is pretty, but watch out for the Spore Puffers. They sneeze.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.boswachter_mos.2: The shrooms here are centuries old. Some are older than the Grandmaster.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.boswachter_mos.3: Follow the beams of light and you'll never get lost. Almost never.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.dichter_daan.1: O Shroomsbury, thou sweetest shroom, where every guh... uh... something with a broom.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.dichter_daan.2: A poet needs inspiration. And coffee. Mostly inspiration.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.dichter_daan.3: Does 'wahoog' rhyme with anything? I've been looking for three years.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.grootmeester.1: Welcome to the temple of the Snuggle Order. Here you switch paths, pick your skills again and grow stronger.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.grootmeester.2: I'm old, but my cuddles are still legendary.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.grootmeester.3: Wahoognir... I knew him when he was still pink. He ate cotton candy out of my paw.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.havenmeester.1: Seagulls, wind and the smell of salt. Lovely. Except the seagulls.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.havenmeester.2: The airship? It's at the Harbor, across the bay. Pilotguh Zeppy will fly you wherever you want.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.havenmeester.3: I count the boats every day. There are three. For years now. But you never know.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kampwacht_grotten_1.1: Light the campfire: then you'll wake up here if you faint. Don't worry, you won't lose a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kampwacht_grotten_1.2: A campfire is a cuddle for your whole body. Sit down for a bit?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kampwacht_grotten_1.3: I guard this little fire with my life. Well, with my pillow.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapitein.1: My balloon ship flies on hot air and good cheer. Mostly good cheer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapitein.2: Don't lean over the railing, recruit. Last week someone lost their plushie over the sea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapitein.3: Wind force: chonk. Visibility: wahoog. Lovely flying weather!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapster_fohnie.1: Your little ears could use a little trim, sweetie.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapster_fohnie.2: The secret to pretty curls? Slime Gel. Real, fresh blob slime.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kapster_fohnie.3: Blow-dry, comb, fluff. In that order. Always.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_mollie.1: A house is only a home with a beanbag in it!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_mollie.2: All handmade, with lots of cuddles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_mollie.3: Pink goes with everything. Really everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_rozenkloof.1: A little house of your own? There's still room in the Snuggle Quarter. I'll take you there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_rozenkloof.2: Cliff dwellings are pretty, but a little garden of your own is prettier.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_rozenkloof.3: Your neighbors in the Snuggle Quarter are very nice. I picked them myself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kk_poort_saffraanpoor: A house with a little dome? You can have that in the Snuggle Quarter. Almost. I'll take you there.
Saffron Gate is full. But the Snuggle Quarter still has plots.
A garden with a fountain? You'll need a pretty big watering can for that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleermaker.1: Clothes from the Chonkdom can come home with you! For your guh, or for yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleermaker.2: A little bow here, a little scarf there. Fashion is a kind of cuddle too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleermaker.3: I sew everything with pink thread. Even the black socks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleine_kiki.1: Have you seen my plushies? They went on an adventure without me!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleine_kiki.2: When I grow up I'll be a knight too. Or a princess. Or a knight-princess!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kleine_kiki.3: I can already count to ten. One, two, three, four, chonk, six...
vadsrijk.npc.praat.klerk.1: The quest board! It shows who in Shroomsbury needs help. A little stamp on it, done.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.klerk.2: I stamp everything. Letters, bounties, my lunch. That last one was a mistake.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.klerk.3: Bounties for brave adventurers! Just sign here... and here... and here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kok.1: Fluffcakes! Fresh off the griddle! They're a bit black on the bottom, but that's how they're supposed to be.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kok.2: If you want to give chonk, you first have to eat well yourself. That's rule one of the Order. Or rule two. After eating.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.kok.3: Smell that? That's the campfire. And a tiny bit my apron.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.koopman_kees.1: Everything's for sale! Except my little cart. That's gone.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.koopman_kees.2: A good trader can sell anything. Even sand in the Drip Caves.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.luchtschipper.1: The airship leaves whenever you want. We're very flexible.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.luchtschipper.2: Back to Camp Snuggle? Say hi to the Camp Blob for me!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.luchtschipper.3: I've been flying for twenty years. I've never once landed without bouncing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.marktmeester.1: Going once, going twice... CHONK! The auction house is open!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.marktmeester.2: Sell your loot to other adventurers. Not bound items, though: those stay with you.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.marktmeester.3: My little tap-tap gavel is the most important hammer in Shroomsbury. Just ask the smith.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.mijnwerker_mopje.1: Drip, drip, drip. All day long. It's getting me a bit soggy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.mijnwerker_mopje.2: Crystals! Crystals everywhere! And slime. Loads of slime.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.mijnwerker_mopje.3: My little lamp is almost out. Luckily the shrooms glow down here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.muzikant_mo.1: Oom-pah-pah, oom-pah-pah... without a tuba it sounds a bit sad.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.muzikant_mo.2: I play at every party in Shroomsbury. Well, I would play. If I had my tuba.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.muzikant_mo.3: Music makes you chonky. That's science. Just ask the professor.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.1: Knitting is just like cuddling, my little chonk. Stitch by stitch.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.2: When I was young, the blobs were still pink and there was only one moon.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.3: Come here, you've got a bit of fluff on your ear. There.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.oma_truus.4: That second moon just showed up one night. It never blinks. Moons shouldn't stare, my little chonk.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.postguh_pim.2: I know every little house on every cap. Except that one. I'm still looking for it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.postguh_pim.3: Rain, wind or Gray Fluff: the mail always gets through. Sometimes a bit sticky.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.priesteres.1: Every path of the Order starts with one small, soft step.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.priesteres.2: The little temple is old, but it still cuddles back when you pet the pillars.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.priesteres.3: Knight, hunter or mage: your heart is what counts. And a bit of your skills.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.professor_pluis.1: Fascinating! Gray Fluff is exactly as soft as normal fluff, but... grumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.professor_pluis.2: I have three degrees in Fluffology. And one in Knitting, from Granny Trudy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.professor_pluis.3: Hypothesis: the Chonklessness is contagious. Conclusion: wash your paws!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.rekruteerder.1: Back straight, ears up, recruit! There. Wahoog.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.rekruteerder.2: A good knight of the Snuggle Order never hits hard. Only very sweetly and very often.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.rekruteerder.3: I once cheered up a hundred blobs in one day. Then I slept for a week. Nyeg.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.ridder_rammel.1: In my day we beat blobs with nothing but a teaspoon! ... Well, cheered them up.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.ridder_rammel.2: My armor rattles a bit. That's how I got my name. Or the other way around.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.ridder_rammel.3: I'm retired. But my thirst for adventure isn't!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.schilder_sien.1: Look at the meadow! All those colors! Well... it used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.schilder_sien.2: I only paint cheerful things. That's why I have so little gray paint.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.schilder_sien.3: My masterpiece is called 'Blob in the Morning Sun'. It got eaten.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.slaapkop_sjors.1: Zzz... huh, what? I wasn't sleeping. I was resting my eyes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.slaapkop_sjors.2: I haven't slept for three nights. Something out there snores really loudly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.slaapkop_sjors.3: A nap is a cuddle for your head.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.smid.1: Stars on it? Sure! But sometimes one pops off. That's the exciting part, nyeg.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.smid.2: Frayed? Bring it here and I'll hammer it smooth again. Nothing is ever truly broken.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.smid.3: I forge with love and a veeery soft hammer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.stalmeester.1: Mounts! They jump, they run and they grow stronger along with you.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.stalmeester.2: A Cloud Lamb floats a little. It's crazy about Root Shrooms.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.stalmeester.3: A mount? First you pick your very own Plumeguh in the Duskroot. After that I've got more for you here!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tempelwachter_steeltj: The Shroom Temple is sacred. And very, very stairy.
The big door only opens for those who help the temple's shrooms.
I've been standing here for a hundred years. My legs have fallen asleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_jager.1: A Fluff Hunter keeps her distance and aims with her heart. And with her eyes, that helps too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_jager.2: Roll Flip! Out of the blob goo, and your next shot hits extra hard.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_jager.3: I can hit an apple from a hundred paces. Then I eat it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_magier.1: Elements, recruit! Fire beats shroom, shroom beats slime, slime beats fire. Pink is good against everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_magier.2: My first fireball was a pink little bubble. It never landed. It's still floating around somewhere.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_magier.3: A Chonk Mage heals too. A circle on the ground, and everyone feels chonky again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_ridder.1: Left-click is your normal bonk. R, V and G are your skills. Z is the big whopper!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_ridder.2: A Snuggle Knight stands at the front. With a pillow. Always with a pillow.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.trainer_ridder.3: Those training dummies can take a punch. They're made of hay and good spirits.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tuinier_tilly.1: My tulips have turned gray! Gray! They were always pink!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tuinier_tilly.2: You have to sing to your plants. My roses love sappy ballads.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tuinier_tilly.3: A garden is like a guh: it grows from attention.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tap.1: Hee hee! Don't tell anyone I'm sitting here!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tap.2: I've been sitting here for ages. A mushroom is my little friend.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tap.3: Tip never searches properly. He always looks under his own bed first.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tip.1: I'm Tip! My sister is called Tap. She's missing. On purpose.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tip.2: Hide-and-seek is the best game ever. Except when you're the seeker.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.tweeling_tip.3: Tap always hides in places with mushrooms. That doesn't narrow it down much around here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.visser_dobber.1: Shhh. The little slimes in the pond don't bite, but they do tickle.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.visser_dobber.2: I've been fishing in this pond for twenty years. I've never seen a fish. Loads of peace and quiet, though.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.visser_dobber.3: My little hat blew away, but I'm sitting just as comfy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wachter_dikkie.1: I guard Shroomsbury. Mostly Baker Ben's little tarts.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wachter_dikkie.2: King Blob is as big as a house. A big house. With an attic.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wachter_dikkie.3: Halt! Who goes there? Oh, you. Carry on.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wapenhandelaar.1: Swords, bows, staffs! All with a soft edge. Safety first.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wapenhandelaar.2: That eye patch? Just style. I see everything fine. Almost everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.wapenhandelaar.3: A good weapon suits your class. A bad weapon suits nobody.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.weerguh_wolkje.1: Today's weather: sunny, with a chance of cuddles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.weerguh_wolkje.2: Ever since the dragon flew over, the sky's been a bit grayish. I don't like it one bit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.weerguh_wolkje.3: Little lights in the night, those are the campfires. The more, the chonkier.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.werver.1: The Snuggle Order wants you! Yes, you. With those ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.werver.2: I've been recruiting at this temple for a hundred years. You're number three.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.werver.3: The portal snores a bit. Old portals do that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.winkelier.1: Potions, candy, bandages with little hearts on them! Come take a look.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.winkelier.2: My fluff potion helps against everything. Except homesickness. Cuddles help with that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.winkelier.3: Everything for an honest Chonk Coin. Bronze, silver or gold!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_bakker.1: Candy cookies! Crunchy on the outside, crystal on the inside!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_bakker.2: My oven is the second warmest spot in Sugarbowl. After the cafe. And the smithy. Third, then.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_bakker.3: Who wants a cookie with a little snowflake on top?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_beeldhouwer.1: Tap, tap, tap. There's always a guh inside a block of ice. If you just tap long enough.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_beeldhouwer.2: My statues melt in summer. That's why it's always winter here. Handy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_beeldhouwer.3: I've seen strange things. Little figures with sleds full of crystal. Heading for the gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_berggids.1: Always follow the little flags. And never the Snow Hares: they don't know the way either.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_berggids.2: When the spires sing, something is coming. Listen closely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_berggids.3: I've climbed every peak. Twice. The second time to fetch my hat.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_breister.1: A sweater for you, a sweater for your guh, a sweater for the sweater.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_breister.2: All the guhs in Sugarbowl wear my sweaters. Except the mayor. He wears two.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_breister.3: Knit, knit, knit. That's my song. It only has one word.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_burgemeester.1: Welcome to Sugarbowl, the warmest spot in the coldest mountains!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_burgemeester.2: Our little town sits inside a giant geode. The pink quartz keeps the warmth in. And the snow out.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_burgemeester.3: I have a chain of office made of rock candy. No licking. I see you looking.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_cafe.1: Hot cocoa! With whipped cream! With marshmallows! With even more whipped cream!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_cafe.2: Anyone with cold pawsies gets a mug from me. That's how it works in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_cafe.3: My secret recipe? A pinch of cinnamon and loads of cuddles in the pan.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_galmpje.1: La la laaa... and the mountains sing laaa back!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_galmpje.2: The crystal spires on the Echo Slopes sing along if you sing well. Or really loudly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_galmpje.3: I sing in the Candy Choir. There are two of us. Me and the echo.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondel_boven.1: Welcome to the top! Careful, it's a bit windy up here. Hold on to your ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondel_boven.2: Back down? The gondola is ready. It only wobbles a tiny bit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondel_boven.3: My brother Cable is down below. I'm up top. We talk through the cable. He never hears a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondelier.1: The gondola to the top! View guaranteed, wobbling too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondelier.2: Don't lean out of the window. Not even if you see a Snow Hare.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_gondelier.3: My cable is a hundred years old. It has never let go. Never ever!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_juwelier.1: Rough crystals from the mountains? I'll set them in your gear in no time. Click, done.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_juwelier.2: A socket in your sword, a little stone in it, and hop: stronger. You can take it out too, nothing breaks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_juwelier.3: Not everything that glitters is a gem. Sometimes it's just my glasses.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kapitein.1: Ice on the hull, snow in my mustache. Lovely! Well. A little bit lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kapitein.2: Back to the Harbor? Pull your scarf tight, it's drafty above the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kapitein.3: I once caught an ice floe with my hat. It melted. The floe, not the hat.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kasguh.1: My greenhouse is warm, my little tomatoes are red, and my little flowers are... gray. Hm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kasguh.2: Everything grows in the geode. Except patience. You have to bring that yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kasguh.3: Green in the snow! Now that's magic.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kwarts.1: The Crystal Guard watches over Sugarbowl. Day and night. In warm socks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kwarts.2: Out there, the Chonklessness turns everything into gray crystal. We don't let it in here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_kwarts.3: Back straight, adventurer. A guard is like a crystal: hard on the outside, pink on the inside.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_1.1: Warm candy cookies! Two for the price of a smile!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_1.2: Everything on my stall is homemade. Except the candles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_1.3: The Christmas market isn't really open until the lanterns are lit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_2.1: Scarves! Mittens! Hats with a pom-pom as big as your head!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_2.2: I knit everything myself. Even in my sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_2.3: Pink looks good on everyone. That's science.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_3.1: Crystal ornaments! They sing softly when you touch them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_3.2: I got them from the Echo Slopes myself. Very carefully.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_marktguh_3.3: One for your tree? Or your little house?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.1: In my day we walked through the snow to school every day. Uphill. Both ways.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.2: My mittens are gone. My pawsies are ice cubes now.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.3: Come here, I'll tell you about the winter of '32. It was cold. The end.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_opa_sneeuwbal.4: That winter a guh came over the peaks from very far away. Skinny as a knitting needle. He ate our pancakes for three weeks and never said a word about where he came from.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_ordemeester.1: This is the Snuggle Order's mountain branch. Small, but heated.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_ordemeester.2: Here you can switch classes, just like with the Grandmaster. And at level 30 a new title awaits you here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_ordemeester.3: Crystal remembers everything. Light, warmth, songs. That's why I love listening to it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_1.1: Waddle waddle. That's how I walk. And how I dance.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_1.2: Penguhs are never cold. Except their little feet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_1.3: That Christmas tree is pretty, but I like the baubles best. To look at.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_2.1: I can't fly, but I can slide really fast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_2.2: Skating? I've got built-in skates. My tummy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_2.3: A little fish with your hot cocoa? No? Too bad.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_3.1: I always wear a tuxedo. You never know when there's a party.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_pinguguh_3.2: Those stalls smell like warm cookies. Mmm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.1: At night the light dances above the peaks. Green and pink. Gorgeous!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.2: I draw star maps. The stars here have guh ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.3: From the high lookout you can see a giant tree far away. Nobody knows what's there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_poollicht.4: I draw constellations with guh ears. But at the far edge hangs a gray fog bank that no star can shine through. It creeps a little closer every year.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_postguh.1: Mail! By sled! Who wants mail?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_postguh.2: Mail in the mountains goes by sled. Downhill, very fast. Uphill... less fast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_postguh.3: I have a letter for the mountain guide, the fisher and the gorge keeper. I just don't feel like climbing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_prisma.1: The Mirror Keep was once the brightest palace in the realm. Now it's gray.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_prisma.2: In the keep you have to bounce the light around. Mirror after mirror.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_prisma.3: Lady Mirrorsigh... she was so cheerful once. She admired herself all day long. Now all she sees is gray.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_1.2: Skating is just sliding really fast with style.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_1.3: If you fall, get up and pretend it was a trick.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_2.1: A lap to the left, a lap to the right, a lap for hot cocoa.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_2.2: I polished the ice just yesterday. With my tummy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatser_2.3: Want to skate with me? There's plenty of room!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatsjuf.1: A lap to the left, a lap to the right, paws apart and... SWOOSH!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatsjuf.2: Falling is no big deal. Getting up is what matters. Then falling again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_schaatsjuf.3: I've been skating since I was a little guh. Back then the ice was still pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_1.1: We're about to sled down! Wheeee!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_1.2: Papa pulls, mama brakes, and I shout wheeee.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_1.3: The best slope is behind the stable. Don't tell anyone.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_2.1: A sled, three guhs and a thermos of hot cocoa. That's a good day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_2.2: Pulling is hard work, but they laugh so loud.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_slee_2.3: Watch out for the bend by the dock!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_smid.1: It's always warm in here. That's thanks to my oven. And my good mood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_smid.2: Stars on, frayed off. I'll hammer everything straight again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_smid.3: Forging iron in the snow? Pfff. Sugarbowl has the warmest smithy in the realm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_1.1: Watch out! Snowball! ...Missed. On purpose, of course.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_1.2: We've got a snowball fort behind the Christmas tree.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_1.3: Want to be on our team? We always win. Sometimes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_2.1: Got you! Oh no, that was the mayor...
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_2.2: A good snowball is round, soft and a little bit pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwbal_2.3: Dumpling always misses. Don't tell him I said that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwpop.1: I'm building the biggest snowman in the Chonkdom! His name is Jack too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwpop.2: A good snowman has a carrot. A great one has two.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_sneeuwpop.3: Snowball fights? Always! But never at Grandpa Snowball. He throws back.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_touwtje.1: Rope bridges wobble. They're supposed to. I think.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_touwtje.2: I know every bridge in Splinter Gorge. And every rope. They don't call me Ropey for nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_touwtje.3: Something's humming down there. For weeks now. Mika machines, I tell you.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_uitvinder.1: Hear that humming? Deep in the mountains? That's no avalanche. That's a machine!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_uitvinder.2: I invented a snowplow that makes its own snow. It doesn't quite work right.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_uitvinder.3: Cogs, springs, little nuts. That's what makes an inventor happy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_veilingmeester.1: Going once, going twice... SOLD to the guh with the warmest hat!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_veilingmeester.2: Even up in the mountains you can trade with other adventurers. Not bound items, though.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_veilingmeester.3: My gavel is made of candyfloss. It makes no sound, but it smells lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_ijsje.1: ...(A teeny tiny guh made of dull gray crystal. It's holding a snowball in its little paw.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_ijsje.2: ...(Its little ears are still standing up in fright.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_pluk.1: ...(A guh of dull gray crystal, with a half-knitted plushie in her little paws.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_snoek.1: ...(A fisher of dull gray crystal, with a fishing rod in his little paws. 'Got... a bite...')
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_snoek.2: ...(A little crystal fish dangles from his rod.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_zwier.1: ...(A guh of dull gray crystal, frozen mid-pirouette. You hear, very softly: 'help...')
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_zwier.2: ...(His little skates still sparkle a bit pink.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_versteend_zwier.3: ...(The crystal is cold, but something warm is beating inside.)
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_visser.1: A hole in the ice, a rod in the hole, and waiting. Lots and lots of waiting.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_visser.2: Fish swim under the ice. And plushies. They don't bite. Too bad.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_visser.3: My ice hole is the finest ice hole on the lake. Round and everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_vlokje.1: My plushies went skating and now they're stuck under the ice!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_vlokje.2: I'm Flake. I'm six. And three quarters.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_vlokje.3: When I grow up, I'll join the Crystal Guard. With a candy spear!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_burcht.1: Light the campfire: this is where you wake up if you faint. Warm and safe. You lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_burcht.2: The Crystal Guard protects the Splinter Peaks. With spears of rock candy and very warm socks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wacht_burcht.3: Hear those spires singing? When they sing off-key, something's coming. Stay alert, adventurer.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wapenhandelaar.1: Swords with a frosty edge, bows with mitten grips. Everything for the mountains!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wapenhandelaar.2: Pointy is good. Too pointy is dangerous. I sell just-right pointy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_wapenhandelaar.3: An adventurer without a good weapon is like hot cocoa without whipped cream. Tragic.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winkelier.1: Warm potions, woolly socks and bandages with snowflakes on them!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winkelier.2: A peppermint for the road? They're free. The potions aren't.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winkelier.3: My little shop smells of mint. That keeps the sniffles out.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winterslaap.1: Zzz... is it spring yet? No? Zzz...
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winterslaap.2: I love winter. You get to sleep the whole time. Only it's too cold to sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z2_winterslaap.3: A hot water bottle, a thick blanket, a plushie. That's all you need.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bladwachter.1: The Canopy Sea is beautiful, but since the zeppelins came, it's gone gray in places.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bladwachter.2: Light my campfire. This is where you'll wake up if things go wrong.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bladwachter.3: At the very top of the tree, above the three canopies, lies something huge. A nest.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bloesem.1: The little blossom tree on the square grows right out of the deck. Isn't that lovely?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bloesem.2: When the wind blows, it rains petals here. Then I dance.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_bloesem.3: Take a sniff. That's spring. Spring every day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_1.1: This bridge wobbles. So do I. We make a good team.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_1.2: Don't look down. I'll do it. It's very far. Okay, now I'm dizzy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_1.3: The bees fly under the bridge. They wave. I think.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_2.1: I'm counting the planks. A hundred and twelve. Yesterday there were a hundred and eleven. Someone's sneakily adding more.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_2.2: I don't live on the bridge, you know. I just really like standing on it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_2.3: Combmeadow is that way. Follow the lanterns.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_3.1: Hear the little mills? Click clack click. It's music to me.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_3.2: Millcorner is further along the branch. Walk slowly, the bridge is ticklish.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_3.3: I'm the bridge keeper. I don't guard anything, but I'm very good at waving.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_4.1: My name's Combsy too! There are seven Combsies here. It's very confusing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_4.2: This is the gangway to the Honey Lift. Mossfoot is down below.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_4.3: I watch the lift every day. Up and down. Up and down. Very relaxing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_5.1: This gangway goes to the airship. Hold on to your hat!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_5.2: I once dropped a honey cake. It never landed. That's how high it is.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_5.3: Upsy-daisy! I say that with every step. That way you don't fall.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_6.1: This cable bridge goes to the Cheese Zeppelin Yard. I don't go there. I just look.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_6.2: When the Mikas test their cannons, the whole bridge shakes. Then I hold on to my little ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_brug_6.3: A hundred and forty blocks long. I counted every one. Twice.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_cafe.1: Welcome to The Sweet Comb! Honey tea, honey cake and honey ice cream. And for the daring: honey with honey.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_cafe.2: In the evenings there's dancing here. On the tables. Don't tell my wife.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_cafe.3: A cup of honey tea? That'll warm your little ears.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_druppel.1: Tonight we're dancing at The Sweet Comb! Are you coming?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_druppel.2: A honey drop falls very slowly. That's how I dance too. Very slowly. And sticky.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_druppel.3: I once danced with a Plumeguh. He stepped on my toe. Both my toes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_gloei.1: It's dark down here. Stay in the light, then the monsters hurt less.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_gloei.2: Hear that? That thumping? That's the heart of the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_gloei.3: My little lamp is my best friend. After my mom.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_herbergier.1: Welcome to the inn of Buzzrest! Beds of moss, soup of blossoms.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_herbergier.2: The floor wobbles here. It's supposed to. We live on a branch.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_herbergier.3: I've got potions and bandages too. A beekeepers' village on a branch has to stock everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_honingbij.1: I'm not a bee, you know. I just have little antennae. On my head. Made of fabric.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_honingbij.2: The bees of Honeybough are the sweetest in the whole realm. They never sting. They cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_honingbij.3: Want to see a bee dance? Look: circle, wiggle, circle. That means: there's cake over there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_1.1: My bees sing in the morning. I sing along. The neighbors find it... special.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_1.2: Harvesting honey takes patience. And a veil. Mostly a veil.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_1.3: Hear that? That's what a happy hive sounds like.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_2.1: Since the Mika zeppelins started coming, the queen bee doesn't sing anymore. I'm worried.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_2.2: Gray honey! In my hive! Who would do such a thing?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_2.3: A beekeeper without bees is like a tree without leaves. Very bare.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_3.1: I once found a honeycomb as big as a door. Now I live in it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_3.2: Did you know bees can count? Up to four. Then they start over.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_3.3: A good beekeeper always has a sweetie in his pocket. For the bees. And for himself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_molenhoek.1: In Millcorner the little mills turn in the branch wind. They grind blossom flour for the honey cake.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_molenhoek.2: A mill standing still means the wind is asleep. Then I sleep too. Only fair.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_molenhoek.3: Watch out for the wasps on the branches. They've gone gray. We haven't, luckily.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_raatweide.1: Welcome to Combmeadow! We live between the combs here. Literally. My bed is hexagonal.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_raatweide.2: Our bees fly to the canopy every morning and back every evening. I always wave them off.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_imker_raatweide.3: When the wind blows, the whole branch wobbles. The bees think it's a party.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_jager.1: New jobs go up on the bounty board every day. Monsters, mold, deliveries. Take whatever you like.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_jager.2: I don't hunt guhs, you know. Only the things that make the tree sick.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_jager.3: A bounty a day keeps the mold away. And the boredom.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_juwelier.1: Amber rose, honey crystal, root crystal... the tree is full of pretty stones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_juwelier.2: A socket in your gear? I'll set a crystal in it in no time. Click, done.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_juwelier.3: Resin is a tree's memory. That's why it sparkles so.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kapitein.1: My balloon is striped. Just like my sweater. Just like my socks. I love stripes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kapitein.2: Back to The Harbor or to Sugarbowl? Grab the travel map, I fly everywhere. Except into the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kapitein.3: I once had a bee as my co-pilot. He only wanted to go to flowers. Very snug flights, those were.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_1.1: I have the same name as Grandma! But smaller.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_1.2: When I grow up I'll be a Plumeguh rider. Or a dragon. A dragon is fine too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_1.3: Do you have a mount? Can I pet it?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_2.1: I'm from Mossfoot! Everything there is made of roots. Here everything is made of honey. I don't know which is tastier.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_2.2: My little wings are made of paper. But shhh.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kind_2.3: I'm not scared of the Mikas. Only a little bit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kleermaker.1: A beekeeper's hat with a veil? Suits everyone. Even Plumeguhs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kleermaker.2: I sew everything with silk thread from the caterpillars here. They love to help.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kleermaker.3: Stripes are slimming. That's why the whole town wears stripes. Kidding. It's just cozy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_knoest.1: ...I am the last little light of the Tree Folk. The others sleep in the wood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_knoest.2: We built this town inside the trunk. Little houses in the wall, along the stairs, all the way around. Long ago.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_knoest.3: Light is warmth. Warmth is life. It's that simple. It used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kuikenhoeder.1: Plume Chicks are sooo cute. And sooo quick to wander off. Where are they now?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kuikenhoeder.2: A Plume Chick follows anything that moves. Especially mounts.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_kuikenhoeder.3: When they grow up, you can ride them. Right now they fit in a teacup.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lampion.1: Every evening I light all the lanterns. All two hundred and twenty-seven of them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lampion.2: When the glow beetles come, I barely have to do a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lampion.3: Light keeps the grayness away. Everybody here knows that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_liftguh.1: The Honey Lift goes all the way down to Mossfoot. Two chains, one honeycomb cabin, lots of courage.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_liftguh.2: Don't look down. Or do. The view is gorgeous.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_liftguh.3: I've been turning this crank for thirty years. My left arm is very strong.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lusje.1: Drawing maps of a tree is hard. Everything goes round. And up. And down.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lusje.2: Buzzrest sits on the Bee Bough. High, wobbly and full of bees. You get used to it. After three weeks or so.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_lusje.3: My tea's gone cold again. Must be the fright. Or me. I always forget it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_markt.1: Buy, sell, swap! The buzzing market is always open.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_markt.2: Today's special: nothing. Tomorrow too. Have a look between the stalls yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_markt.3: Here you can swap anything with other adventurers. Fair is fair, says the bee.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_molenaar.1: My waterwheel runs on tree sap. Slowly, but it turns.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_molenaar.2: When the mold comes, it gets stuck. Then I push. Hard.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_molenaar.3: A little spin is good for everyone. Even for a wheel.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_nestwachter.1: ...I kept the egg warm. For a very long time. I'd almost forgotten why.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_nestwachter.2: The Tree Folk carried the egg down. I stayed. Someone had to stay.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_nestwachter.3: Now I'm pink again. That feels... nice. Thank you.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_opa_bast.1: When I was young, I climbed the inner stairs to the nest every day. Now I climb to my chair every day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_opa_bast.2: Long ago a dragon sang in the canopy. Very softly. You could only hear it if you were quiet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_opa_bast.3: My bees are all called Bea. Makes calling them easy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_postguh.1: Delivering mail in a tree is tricky. Everything is above, below or behind.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_postguh.2: I have a letter for someone called 'The Little Finger'. No idea who that is. It's still in my bag.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatje.1: Welcome to Honeybough, sweetie. A little town on a branch, and the branch on a tree as big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatje.2: I'm the mayor, the beekeeper and everyone's grandma here. Mostly grandma.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatje.3: Honey, blossoms and a warm blanket. That's all a guh needs. Well, plushies too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatwever.1: I build the combs for the houses. Little hexagons, all day long. I even dream in hexagons.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatwever.2: There's a beekeeper's suit on the clothesline that nobody recognizes. Weird, huh?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_raatwever.3: A hexagon is the strongest shape. And the coziest.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_1.1: I've been walking around this tree for three days. I'm not even halfway yet. I think.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_1.2: The bridle path around the trunk? Gorgeous. But I don't have a Plumeguh. So I walk. Slowly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_1.3: A campfire, a cup of tea, and a tree as big as a mountain. That's all a traveler wants.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_2.1: I'm mapping where the mold vats are. For Loopy. She doesn't dare herself. Fear of heights, she says. On the ground.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_2.2: Those Mikas over in the west smell like old socks. And cheese. Mostly cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_2.3: My compass always points at the tree. Either the compass is broken, or the tree is very important.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_3.1: See that cable bridge up there? That's where the Mikas go to their yard. I'm staying right here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_3.2: I was on my way to Highchonk. Then I saw this tree. I've been here a month now.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_3.3: Campfire on, shoes off, toes warm. That's how travel should be.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_4.1: I rode the bridle path all the way up here. My Plumeguh is asleep now. Almost me too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_4.2: From canopy 1 you can see the yard on its own island. With a spyglass you can even see the cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_reiziger_4.3: The wind columns only go up. Going down, you glide. That's the deal in this tree.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_smid.1: My fire burns on beeswax. Smells lovely and glows pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_smid.2: Stars on, frays off. Everything gets sturdy again here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_smid.3: The only day I don't forge is Sunday. Then I bake waffles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_stalguh.1: Saddles, colors and feed. See what your Plumeguh likes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_stalguh.2: I tidy the stable. Every day. Plumeguhs lose a lot of feathers. A whole lot.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_stalguh.3: When a Plumeguh sneezes, it leaves a cloud of down behind. I love this job.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_theeguh.1: Honey tea with marsh flowers. That gives you speedy little paws!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_theeguh.2: I'm a frog guh. I like living near the water. And near the tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_veertje.1: Brushing a Plumeguh is the best job in the world. After feeding Plumeguhs. And cuddling Plumeguhs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_veertje.2: You ride with your knees, your heart and a bag of Honey Bites.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_veertje.3: Hear that trampling? That's the practice track. Or my tummy. It's almost lunchtime.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wacht_gewelf.1: Light the campfire: this is where you wake up if you faint. Warm, safe, and you lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wacht_gewelf.2: The Honey Guard protects the routes through the tree. With spears of reed and lots and lots of honey cake.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wacht_gewelf.3: Out there are real monsters, adventurer. Not guhs. Be brave, and come back before dark.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wapens.1: Branch clubs, vine bows, blossom staves. All picked from the tree. With permission!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wapens.2: Pointy as a bee's stinger. But nice.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wapens.3: Choose your weapon with your heart. And with your class.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wasja.1: This is the Nest Chapel, the Snuggle Order's branch office in the tree. Here you can change class.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wasja.2: Long ago the Order put an egg pedestal here. Empty. Nobody remembers what for.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wasja.3: Bees dance to show the way. I dance to stay warm. Everyone has their reasons.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_winkel.1: Potions, bandages and honey drops! Everything for the road.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_winkel.2: A potion with a honey rim works twice as well. Says my grandma. My grandma is Combsy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wortelien.1: Welcome to Mossfoot! We live at the bottom of the tree, between the roots. Nice and cozy, and always cool.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wortelien.2: Our waterwheel runs on sap. It smells like maple syrup. Everyone here is always hungry.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_wortelien.3: The roots are rotting. We notice it in everything. Even the soup tastes gray.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_zoemer.1: I have little wings! They don't do anything, but they ARE very pretty.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_zoemer.2: Buzz buzz! I'm a bee! A big bee! With little ears!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z3_zoemer.3: Do you know where the queen bee lives? I'm never allowed to go there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_bankier.1: Want to keep your things safe? With me, everything goes in a big shell. A really big one. With a lock.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_bankier.2: I pay interest in little shells. Kidding. Or not. Check your vault.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_bankier.3: A smart guh saves. An even smarter guh saves in a vault that can't sink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_danseres.1: In the evenings we dance on the quay, under the lanterns. Are you coming?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_danseres.2: The wave dance goes like this: to, fro, to, and then splash.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_danseres.3: I dance for the plushies coming home. So they feel welcome.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duikmeester.1: Underwater, Coral Bay is even prettier than above. Pink coral, shiny fish and three secret little grottos.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duikmeester.2: Goggles on, breathe in, and splash! Come back up before you turn blue. Or pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duikmeester.3: In the deepest grotto lies something big and sad. I don't dare go near it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duinwachter.1: From the Lantern Dune you can see everything: the Tree behind you, Highchonk ahead of you, and all the little islands in between.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duinwachter.2: Light the campfire. This is where you wake up if things go wrong. Warm, safe, and you lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_duinwachter.3: The creatures here are gray and sad. Cheer them up, adventurer. It'll make you happy too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_feestguh.1: It's always a party here! A little party in the morning, a medium party in the afternoon and a big party in the evening.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_feestguh.2: The campfire never goes out. I make sure of that. With marshmallows.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_feestguh.3: Dancing around the campfire? Your feet will know how all by themselves.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_grijsje.1: I'm from the east. Everything there is gray. Here everything is pink. I still have to get used to it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_grijsje.2: My plushie is called Mouse. I lost him while we were fleeing. Maybe he'll wash ashore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_grijsje.3: Foster Mom Softie gives me warm milk every night. With a straw!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_havenmeester.1: Welcome to Lanternhaven! Houses on stilts, lanterns on every rope, and the sea is pink. Really. Take a look.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_havenmeester.2: See that city above the sea? Highchonk. On the back of a whale. I look at it every morning with my coffee.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_havenmeester.3: A harbor without boats is a bathtub. A harbor without lanterns is... well, also a bathtub. But dark.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_hemelkapitein.1: My airship is built to go up. Way, way up. All the way above the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_hemelkapitein.2: Highchonk is the most beautiful city in the world. I was born there. On the back of a whale. Weird, huh?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_hemelkapitein.3: When the whale comes down low, we take off. Not before. Even I can't fly that high.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_imker.1: My bees make pink honey. From the flowers here. Have a taste, it tastes like summer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_imker.2: A bee farm on an island is nice. The bees can't run away. They can fly away, though. And they do.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_imker.3: Buzz buzz. That's bee talk for 'good morning'. Or for 'watch out'. Depends.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_golfje.1: I can swim already! With water wings. And with Mom right next to me. But all by myself!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_golfje.2: There's a crab under the jetty. His name is Pinchy. I named him myself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_golfje.3: Do you have your own little boat? Can I come along? I'm very light.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_lampje.1: I made a lantern! It's crooked. But it's lit!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_lampje.2: Do you know why the sea is pink? I think there's a really big strawberry in it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kind_lampje.3: When I grow up I'll be a kite champion. Or a whale. A whale is fine too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kleermaker.1: Striped sailor sweaters, sun hats and swim caps! Who doesn't want to hit the sea in style?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kleermaker.2: I sew with sail thread. It never tears. Unless you laugh really hard.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kleermaker.3: A scarf against the sea wind, and you're ready for anything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kok.1: Welcome to The Happy Halibut! Fish soup, shrimp cakes and seaweed ice cream. That last one is better than it sounds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kok.2: I only cook with fish that wanted to join in. Very honest fish soup.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_kok.3: A bowl of soup? That'll warm your little ears after a day at sea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_lampionmaker.1: Pink, yellow and mint. A lantern doesn't need more colors than that. Well, maybe lilac. For Sundays.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_lampionmaker.2: A lantern is a little sun on a string. You can take it anywhere.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_lampionmaker.3: When Snuggletide comes, we hang up a thousand of them. Then the plushies can find their way home.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_limonade.1: Seashell Lemonade! Pink, sweet and with a seagrass straw. Have a taste!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_limonade.2: The secret is in the little shells. They give it a hint of sea. A teeeeny hint of sea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_limonade.3: A glass of lemonade and a parasol. That's all a beach needs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_luchthaven.1: From this platform the airships fly back to the Tree and beyond. Grab the travel map.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_luchthaven.2: The airship to Highchonk? It doesn't leave from here. For that you need the Liftoff Pier, way out east.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_luchthaven.3: Wind from the west: good flying weather. Wind from the east: gray weather. I don't like that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_madelief.1: A flower wreath makes everyone pretty. Even a Mika. Well, almost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_madelief.2: I'm weaving wreaths for the snuggle festival. One for every plushie that comes home.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_madelief.3: Take a sniff. That's the sea and the flowers together. My favorite smell.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_mama_pluis.1: My fluff is almost back. Look, my little ears are already turning a bit pink.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_mama_pluis.2: I once had a whole cupboard full of plushies. They took them all. For the Bowl, they said.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_mama_pluis.3: Thank you for being here. It feels like home here. A new home.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_markt.1: Buy, sell, swap! The coast market is always open, even when it rains. Then we have parasols.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_markt.2: Today's special: sand. Free. It's everywhere.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_markt.3: Here you can swap with other adventurers. Fair is fair, says the shell.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_nevel.1: I came through the fog. From the east. I don't dare go any further yet. Here it's... in between.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_nevel.2: In the fog you hear voices. They say: 'Quiet is quick.' I don't want to be quiet anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_nevel.3: Beyond the fog the gray land begins. I got out. I'm never going back.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_oma_zeeschuim.1: When I was little, a plushie washed ashore for me every year. A little duck. It's still on my windowsill.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_oma_zeeschuim.2: The Great Snuggletide comes once a year. When the lanterns light up. I always watch the water then.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_oma_zeeschuim.3: This year they're gray. I've never seen that before. Never.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opa_dun.1: Where I come from, sharing isn't allowed. Sharing is silly, they say there. Here everyone shares everything.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opa_dun.2: I've almost lost all my chonk. But the soup here helps. Every day another spoonful of chonk.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opa_dun.3: Do you know what I missed most? Laughing. Just laughing. About nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opvang.1: Welcome to the shelter. Everyone is welcome here: guhs, plushies, and sad little critters.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opvang.2: A cup of warm milk, a little blanket and a cuddle. That perks anyone right up.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_opvang.3: The guhs from the east are skinny and quiet. But every day they laugh a little more.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_pierwachter.1: The Liftoff Pier. This is where the airships take off for Highchonk. Well, soon. When the whale comes down low enough.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_pierwachter.2: I've been waiting years for the first airship. I'm already wearing my best cap.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_pierwachter.3: Look up. That shadow on the water? That's Mother Cloudwhale. She swims through the sky.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_postguh.1: Mail between the little islands goes by message in a bottle. I toss it in the water and the current does the rest. Usually.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_postguh.2: Sometimes a message in a bottle washes up from far, far away. From the east. Those notes are... gray.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_postguh.3: Buzz buzz, mail! Oh no, that was the Tree. Here it's: splish splash, mail!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schelpie.1: I live on Granny Bobber. She's been asleep for a hundred years. Her husband, Old Bobber, swims circles around her and comes to rest by the jetty for a bit every lap.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schelpie.2: Every morning I wake up somewhere else. Very adventurous, for a hermit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schelpie.3: Old Bobber is a hundred years old. Or two hundred. He won't say. He doesn't say much anyway.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schipper.1: I've been sailing between the little islands for forty years. I know every wave by name.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schipper.2: Careful near the Gray Fog Bank in the southeast. That's where you lose your compass. And your good mood.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_schipper.3: A good boat is like a good friend. It takes you anywhere and never says no.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_smid.1: I forge anchors, hooks and swords. Mostly anchors. The sea is big.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_smid.2: Salt water rusts everything. That's why I polish my hammer every evening. It shines like a pearl.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_smid.3: Bring me your gear. Stars on, rust off.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_soepguh.1: Soup for everyone! Even if you're not hungry. Then you get a little bowl.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_soepguh.2: The guhs from the east haven't had anything warm for so long. I make a big pot every day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_soepguh.3: My secret ingredient? A cuddle. Not in the soup, silly. After the soup.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vaaltje.1: We came through the fog in a little boat. It was very cold. And very quiet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vaaltje.2: I've never seen a lantern before. Can I hold one?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vaaltje.3: Here the creatures are gray, but they want to be cheered up. Over there it's different. Over there nothing is allowed to be happy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_visser.1: Fishing is waiting. And waiting is nice too. Especially with a sandwich.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_visser.2: Yesterday I caught a boot. Today a fish in a boot. Tomorrow maybe the other boot.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_visser.3: Cast the line, watch the bobber, don't fall asleep. That last one is the hardest.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vliegermaker.1: A guh kite has little ears, a little face and a tail with bows. Otherwise it won't fly. Really.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vliegermaker.2: It's always windy on this island. That's why I live here. And because my hat keeps blowing away here, so I can't leave.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_vliegermaker.3: Sticks, fabric, string and a ribbon. That's all you need. And patience. Lots of patience.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_volleybal.1: Beach volleyball! Ball over the net, not into the sea. I never manage that last part.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_volleybal.2: I've never lost. I've never won either. I always play alone.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_volleybal.3: Come on, one game! I'll give you a head start. Of zero points.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wacht_bloemen.1: Light the campfire: this is where you wake up if you faint. Warm, safe, and you lose nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wacht_bloemen.2: The Coast Guard keeps the lanterns burning and the boats in one piece. And we share our cookies.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wacht_bloemen.3: The creatures on the coast are gray and sad. Cheer them up, adventurer. One pink poof and they're happy again.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wachter.1: I've been keeping the lighthouse for sixty years. Every evening I light the lamp. Even when there are no boats.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wachter.2: A lighthouse says: here is land, here is warmth, come on in. That's all. It doesn't need to say more.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wachter.3: From up top I can see all the currents. The sea tells me everything. If I listen closely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wapens.1: Harpoons, nets and seashell shields. Everything a coast knight needs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wapens.2: My harpoons are very nice. They only poke monsters. And sausages.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wapens.3: Choose your weapon with your heart. But also with your class, or it won't fit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wasguh.1: In the plushie laundry, gray plushies turn pink again. With soap, warm water and lots and lots of love.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wasguh.2: Then they hang on the clothesline to dry. Look, half of them are pink again already!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_wasguh.3: I wash everything. Plushies, socks, and sometimes the cat by accident.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_werkplaats.1: Here we tinker, saw and tie knots. Just like on a ship. But on dry land.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_werkplaats.2: Tying nets, stringing kites, varnishing boats. I do it all. Except the dishes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_werkplaats.3: What you make yourself lasts longer. And it smells of sawdust. Lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_windmeester.1: I'm the referee of the great kite contest. I keep an eye on the wind. And on cheaters.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_windmeester.2: Whoever keeps their kite in the wind longest at the contest pole wins. It's that simple.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_windmeester.3: The big contest kite up there? That's mine. His name is Gary.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_winkel.1: Potions, bandages and sunscreen for your little ears! Everything for a day at the coast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_winkel.2: A guh without a beach bag is like a beach without sand. Weird.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_winkel.3: Feel free to look around. Watch out for the crab, he lives in the till.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_zeilverhuur.1: A little sailboat with ears! The sail has a little face. It winks when the wind is right.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_zeilverhuur.2: Go ahead and sail around. Just not too far: at the edge the Ring Current gently turns you back. Like a merry-go-round.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z4_zeilverhuur.3: I once built a boat out of a teacup. It sank. But very snugly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_bakker.1: Cloudbuns! So fluffy they float away if you don't watch out!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_bakker.2: Every morning I bake a thousand rolls for the soup kitchen. And one for me. A big one.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_bakker.3: You can buy potions and treats for the road from me.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_1.1: Every day is a party in Highchonk. Today we're celebrating Tuesday!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_1.2: I've got confetti in my ears. For three weeks now. It comes with the territory.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_1.3: Have you seen the whale wink yet? She does it once a day. I've been waiting for hours.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_2.1: Highchonk is so beautiful. I've lived here forty years and I'm still amazed.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_2.2: If you look over the edge, you can see the sea. Very, very far below us.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_2.3: I heard there's a spy in the city. Exciting. Scary. But mostly exciting.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_3.1: I'm a cloudguh. I was born here, on the whale's back.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_3.2: Sometimes you can feel her breathing. Then the streets go up and down very gently.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_3.3: Mother Cloudwhale has been sleeping so restlessly lately. She rumbles in her sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_4.1: I catch cloud ducklings! They dissolve when you hug them. Then I make new ones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_4.2: My mom says the whale's tail is a slide. I'm not allowed on it yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_4.3: Are you a knight? Can I hold your sword? It's a pillow! Fun!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_5.1: From here you can see Mother Cloudwhale's eye. It's as big as a pond. With eyelashes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_5.2: If you wave, she blinks back. Really.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_5.3: In the east there's a gray streak on the horizon. I'd rather not look at it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_6.1: I'm flying to Sugarbowl today. Or tomorrow. Or the day after. I can't decide.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_6.2: The Skyport has a clock tower. It strikes every hour. Except when the bell ringer is asleep.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_burger_6.3: Did you know you can jump right off the piers into the clouds? Don't. Really, don't.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_donsveer.1: I am the commander of the Cloudwatch. I have no time for chitchat. I do have time for cookies.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_donsveer.2: Hmph. What do you want? I'm busy. With... orders. Yes. Very important orders.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_donsveer.3: La la laaa... What? Nothing. I wasn't singing. Generals don't sing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gildemeester.1: Welcome to the Crafters' Guild! Highchonk is the capital of all professions. This is where you learn the Masterworks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gildemeester.2: Mining, woodcutting, gathering, fishing, beekeeping, smithing, sewing, cooking and brewing. Nine professions, one guild.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gildemeester.3: The workshops are open! Talk to a mentor and you'll be at the workbench in no time.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gouddraad.1: I am the treasurer of the High Council. I count everything. Coins, buttons, stars. Yesterday I counted my toes. Ten!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gouddraad.2: The bank of Highchonk has the thickest vault in the world. It's mostly full of candy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_gouddraad.3: I fly off often. But that's private. Very private. Hmph.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_grauwsnor.1: I crossed the Occupied Lands on foot. With my grandchildren on my back. All at once.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_grauwsnor.2: My mustache used to be pink. It'll turn pink again, they say. With enough soup.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_grauwsnor.3: I write a letter home every day. I don't know if they arrive. But writing helps.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_havenmeester.1: Welcome to the Highchonk Skyport! Three piers, a hundred airships a day, and one very strict pigeon.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_havenmeester.2: I know exactly who arrives and who leaves. It's all in my logbook. Well, almost all.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_havenmeester.3: Want to travel? I have the travel map. Pick where you want to go.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_hofdame.1: I knit the Queen's crown. A new one every winter. This one has an extra pom-pom. To make it cozy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_hofdame.2: A queen with a cold head is a grumpy queen. That's why I knit.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_hofdame.3: There's a loose thread in the crown. Don't tell the Queen.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inktvlek.1: I am the archivist. I keep all the old books of the Order. Shhh. Books are sleeping.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inktvlek.2: Tea and books don't mix. Everybody knows that. Me too. Now I do.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inktvlek.3: The oldest books are in the Council Hall. I have the key. And the Chancellery has the spare.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inspecteur.1: Elementary, my dear knight. Well, almost. I still have to find out what 'elementary' means.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inspecteur.2: A good detective looks at the little things. Crumbs. Hairs. Tea stains. And sometimes at cookies. For energy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_inspecteur.3: My magnifying glass has solved three cases already. And once set a tablecloth on fire by accident.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_juwelier.1: Setting gems? Removing them? I do it with tweezers and lots and lots of patience.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_juwelier.2: Sparkling isn't vain. Sparkling is cozy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_juwelier.3: They say the Duchess of the Gray Fleet wears ten rings. On her TOES. What taste.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kadet_dons.1: I'm lost. Again. Highchonk has so many streets. And they all go uphill.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kadet_dons.2: Do you know where the Academy is? I have to salute at twelve o'clock.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kadet_dons.3: I'm very brave. Just not when I'm lost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kleermaker.1: Clothes make the guh. Or the guh makes the clothes. I haven't figured it out yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kleermaker.2: Want to look fancy for the Queen? Come try something on.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kleermaker.3: I made a cape for the Chancellor. He wanted it extra long. Down to the floor. Strange.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kok.1: Soup! Hot soup! For everyone who comes skinny from the east. A bowl full of chonk, with a bit of parsley.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kok.2: My pot is so big I need a stepladder for it. And a long ladle. Hence my name.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_kok.3: Come in skinny, leave full. That's the rule of the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_koningin.1: Come here, knight. A queen may hug whoever she likes. It's the law. I wrote it myself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_koningin.2: My crown is knitted. Gold is cold, wool is warm. A queen has to be warm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_koningin.3: Mother Cloudwhale has been swimming through the sky for ages. As long as we sing, she stays afloat.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_brouwe: Brewing a potion is like singing a song. If it bubbles, you're doing it right.
My cauldron goes 'plop'. That means it's happy.
Come along to the brewery. I'll teach you the Master Potions there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_imkere: I'm from Honeybough. The bees of Highchonk make cloud honey. It's so light it drips upward.
A beehive of your own? You bet! Come along to the apiary.
Bees are the hardest workers in the world. After Cook Ladle.
Cooking is love in a pan. With salt. Not too much salt.
The recipes of Highchonk are the tastiest in the world. I'm the one saying it, and I'm honest.
Come along to the kitchen. I'll teach you the Master Recipes there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_naaien: I'm sewing a giant quilt of all the zones. One patch per zone. Highchonk will be the pink patch.
A stitch, a knot, a cuddle. That's how you sew.
Come along to the studio. I'll teach you Master Tailoring there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_leermeester_smeden: A good sword is soft on guhs and hard on the gray.
Custom work! Handmade gear with your own bonuses. That's what it's all about.
Come along to the forge. I'll teach you Master Smithing there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_lientje.1: Market! Market! You'll find everything here. Except peace and quiet. Peace and quiet is sold out.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_lientje.2: Want to sell something? Or buy? The auction house is right here, with me.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_lientje.3: At the Highchonk market they even sell clouds. In little bags. They do sell out fast.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_mientje.1: I'm from the east. Everything is gray there. Here everything is pink. I'm still getting used to all this color.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_mientje.2: This soup is the tastiest thing I've ever eaten. I eat it very slowly. So it lasts longer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_mientje.3: At night I can't sleep very well. So I watch the stars. And whoever's sneaking around.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisje.1: I lost my plushie. His name is Flop. He has one ear. The other ear is lost too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisje.2: At home everything was gray. Here I'm allowed to be pink. Look, my cheeks are turning pink already!
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisje.3: Mama says we're safe here. Because the whale swims so high.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisninja.2: You didn't see me. That's good. You only see a Fluff Ninja when it's too late. For a cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_pluisninja.3: Fast, soft, invisible. Soon you can do it too. Look in my display case. Quietly.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_plukje.1: I'm the youngest cadet of the Cloudwatch. My helmet is still too big. It keeps sliding over my eyes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_plukje.2: My family still lives in the east. I miss them so much.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_plukje.3: I practice my salute every day. Look. Ow. My helmet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_professor.1: The university of Highchonk is the oldest in the world. The oldest book is so old it sneezes when you open it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_professor.2: I study Mother Cloudwhale. Her breath, her heartbeat, her dreams. Especially her dreams.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_professor.3: Did you know a cloudwhale sleeps with one eye open? So do I. During meetings.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_smid.1: My hammer sings. Tink, tink, tonk. The tonk is a wrong note. It's supposed to be there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_smid.2: Cloudwatch weapons? I make them all. Soft on the outside, strong on the inside.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_smid.3: Come on in if you'd like something made.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stalmeester.1: Your mount can rest here. Cloud hay, warm stables, and a song at bedtime.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stalmeester.2: Plumeguhs love it here. So close to the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stalmeester.3: Want to go to the stable? Come along.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stekje.1: Tail Park sits on the tail of Mother Cloudwhale. When she swims, the trees wiggle along a little.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stekje.2: Blossom trees get thirsty. So do I. I share my watering can with them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_stekje.3: Watch out for the pond. The ducklings are made of cloud. They quack mist.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vadszanger.1: La-la-laaa! I'm a Chonk Singer. My songs make guhs stronger and creatures softer.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vadszanger.2: With my guh flute I play a song that hums your wounds shut. Well, almost. I'm still practicing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vadszanger.3: Soon you can become a Chonk Singer too. Take a look in my display case.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_veerkracht.1: The Cloudwatch protects Highchonk. With shield, with plume and with very good manners.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_veerkracht.2: We march on the parade ground every morning. Left, right, left, cuddle. That's the last step.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_veerkracht.3: A knight of the Order in my Academy? What an honor. Call me Feather.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_1.1: Is this really soup? With flavor? I thought soup always tasted like nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_1.2: In the east the posters say sharing is silly. Here they share everything. I don't quite get it yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_2.1: We fled over the Toll Bridge. Hanging from a kite. Don't look down, Mama said.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_2.2: My tummy is making a noise. That's not hunger anymore. That's happiness.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_2.3: Can I have another bowl later? For my little brother. He's very small.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_3.1: I used to be a baker. Now I'm mostly tired. But maybe tomorrow I'll be a baker again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_3.2: The Mikas took all our flour. And our songs. How do you take a song?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_3.3: Everything here smells of soup and flowers. I'm crying a little. The good kind.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_4.1: I brought a little stone from home. It's gray. But it's from home.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_4.2: On the whale it's so quiet and soft. Like living on a cloud. Which you are.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_vluchteling_4.3: When I grow up I'm joining the Cloudwatch. Then I'll protect the soup kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_1.1: Light the campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. Even in the safest city in the world.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_1.2: The Cloudwatch guards Highchonk. With shield, plume and a whistle for when things get exciting.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_1.3: Highchonk is safe, knight. Nobody fights here. Except over the last cookie.
