vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_6.2: The Cloudwatch guards Highchonk. With shield, plume and a whistle for when things get exciting.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_wacht_6.3: Highchonk is safe, knight. Nobody fights here. Except over the last cookie.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zachtpels.1: Ah, the brave knight! What an honor. A cookie? I always carry a few. For friends.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zachtpels.2: I'm the Queen's right hand. Her left hand is very nice too, but it has less to do.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zachtpels.3: Highchonk is so... warm. So pink. So... shared. Lovely. Really. Lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zuster.1: Welcome to the Order Cathedral. Every evening we sing the song of the First Snuggle here.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zuster.2: Look up. The light through the glass falls in every color. Even colors that don't have a name yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z5_zuster.3: The Great Gate is so tall that clouds sometimes drift right through it. Then we sing louder.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_kloof.1: The bank of Rose Gorge is inside the rock. The safest vault in the Silklands. It's mostly full of sand. And money.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_kloof.2: Your things are just as safe here as in Highchonk. It's the same vault. That's magic. Or bookkeeping.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_kloof.3: Interest? I'll give you one date a year. A big one.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_poort.1: The bank of Saffron Gate. The vault stands on stilts, in case the river ever gets too excited.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_poort.2: Anything you leave with one banker, you can pick up from any banker. Here too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bankier_poort.3: I count coins in my sleep. Yesterday I got to eleven. Then I woke up.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bron.2: I am the spring of all sweet water. I was tired. Very tired. Not anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_bron.3: Whoever follows the star path always finds water. I promise.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_1.1: I live on the second ledge. Every morning I walk down. Every evening I walk up. My calves are famous.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_1.2: When the sun sinks into the gorge, everything turns pink. Even pinker than it already was.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_1.3: Have you seen the whale? You can see her from the Sea Mouth. Like a little cloud with a tail.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_2.1: My balcony looks out on the neighbors' balcony. We wave every day.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_2.2: My flower box has desert roses. They hardly need any water. Just like me. Almost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_2.3: We used to see the beacons burning at night. Now we only see the neighbors.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_3.1: You can get lost in the bazaar. I've lived here thirty years and I'm still a little lost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_3.2: Under the domes, beams of light fall inside. Sometimes I dance in them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_3.3: Smell that? Cardamom. And cinnamon. And a bit of humpguh.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_4.1: The river gets a little lower every week. You can tell by the marks on the quay.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_4.2: If the Mother Oasis dries up, everything dries up. Then we'll have to move. But where to?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_4.3: A felucca is a little boat with a triangular sail. I have three. They're called One, Two and Three.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_5.1: Everything grows in the Paradise Garden. Pomegranates, oranges, roses and lots and lots of tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_5.2: The four canals stand for the four directions. Or for four kinds of tea. We don't remember anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_5.3: Sometimes a veiled lady sits here. She doesn't say anything. She just looks at her toes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_6.1: I'm a caravanguh. I can sleep on a humpguh at full gallop.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_6.2: Without the beacons we don't dare to travel anymore. We've been stuck here for weeks.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_burger_6.3: Granny Date is the bravest of us all. She just travels anyway. With a teapot.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel.1: I'm Granny Date and this is my caravan. Small but sweet. Just like me. Well, I'm not that small.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel.2: Lumpy, my humpguh, carries everything. Except me. I like to walk. That gives me an excuse for a nap.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel.3: La-la-LAA-la-lo... That's the caravan song. Every caravan sings it. That's how the stars find you again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel_serai.1: My caravan rests here. The humpguhs drink, the guhs eat, and I take a nap. That's how it goes.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel_serai.2: The Caravanserai is the home of all caravans. There's always tea, and always someone with a story.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadel_serai.3: La-la-LAA-la-lo. Hum along. Then the stars will find us.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadelpit.1: Welcome to the Palm Gorges! The sweetest dates in the world grow here. If the little monkeys don't pinch them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadelpit.2: The waterfalls sing here day and night. I sing along. Nobody hears it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_dadelpit.3: Up on the plateau stands the Palm Beacon. It's been dark for weeks. It makes my palms sad.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_franje.1: Carpets! For sitting on, for lying on and, if you're very sweet, for flying on.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_franje.2: Flying? Only a carpet of starsilk can do that. Button makes those in Saffron Gate. I sell the ordinary ones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_franje.3: This carpet is a hundred years old. You can tell by the coffee stain. That's a hundred years old too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_glans.1: I polish the mirrors in the Hall of Mirrors. All thousand of them. Every day. They shine when you look into them. So do I.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_glans.2: In a mirror you see everything, knight. Even what isn't there.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_glans.3: I'm just a simple mirror polisher. Very simple. Nothing special. Move along.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_hobbel.1: Humpguhs! They have two humps. One is full of water. The other is full of coziness.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_hobbel.2: A humpguh walks over sand like it's a pillow. Faster than any Plumeguh. Don't tell a Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_hobbel.3: A humpguh has two seats. Bring a friend. Or a big bag.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kaneelstok.1: I am the Grand Vizier. I arrange everything for the Sultana. Even things that don't need arranging.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kaneelstok.2: An audience? That can be done. After tea. And after the tea after that.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kaneelstok.3: Lately two of me have been seen in the palace. That's strange. There's only one of me. Right?
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kardemom.1: Spices! Cardamom, cinnamon, saffron and a secret spice that smells like cuddles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kardemom.2: Haggling is part of the fun. But whoever haggles sweetly gets a bigger discount. That's how it works in the bazaar.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_kardemom.3: Come to me for potions and snacks for the road.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knars.1: The norias scoop water up out of the river. They creak and sing. Or they used to sing.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knars.2: A noria without a song is a sad wheel. I can feel it in my teeth.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knars.3: Creak. Creak. That's not a name, that's a sound. But it's also my name.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knoopje.1: I weave carpets. Ordinary ones, pretty ones and flying ones. You have to hold on tight to the flying ones.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knoopje.2: You make a flying carpet from starsilk. Silk from the mulberry trees, with a pinch of stardust.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_knoopje.3: My tassels keep blowing away. They want to fly too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_koperkop.1: Tink, tonk, tink. My hammer sings in the bazaar. My neighbors sing back. A bit less happily.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_koperkop.2: Saffron Gold is soft on the outside and strong on the inside. Just like a guh.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_koperkop.3: Come on in if you'd like something made.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_korrel.1: Salt! White salt, pink salt, and at night, sparkly salt. That last one tastes like stars.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_korrel.2: My salt-boiling hut has half caved in. The little salt crayfish threw a party in it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_korrel.3: Under the Salt Flats there's a cave that sings. I hear her through the floor at night.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_brouwe: Rosewater, stardust potions, and polishing salt crystals. My brewery smells like everything at once.
A potion with stardust makes you glow softly at night. Handy in the desert.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_imkere: Orange blossom honey. Saffron Honey. The bees in the Paradise Garden are very posh.
A bee in the desert gets thirsty. That's why they live by the fountains.
Come along, and I'll explain everything.
Saffron rice with dates. Rosewater Turkish delight. And tea with cardamom. I'll teach you everything.
You make a Caravan Meal for everyone at once. That's the only proper way.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_naaien: Starsilk! Cocoons from the mulberry trees and a pinch of stardust. So soft you sink right into it.
I sew saddle blankets for humpguhs. They're picky. Stripes, please.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_leermeester_smeden: Smithing Saffron Gold is like kneading honey. Warm, slow and a little bit sticky.
With Star Iron you make the prettiest jewelry. It's rare, but you can find it in Ruin Valley.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_lokum.1: Setting gems? Taking them out? I do it with tweezers and a little Turkish delight to keep calm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_lokum.2: Saffron Gold is the prettiest gold in the world. It smells a little like rice.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_lokum.3: They say there's a duchess with ten rings. On her toes. I'd love to take a peek.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_mientje.1: It's me, Minnie! From the soup kitchen in Highchonk. I came along. And more are coming.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_mientje.2: They come along the East Route. Skinny and gray. Just like I used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pistache.1: Everything is for sale. Except my mustache. That belonged to my grandpa.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pistache.2: Want to sell something? The Saffron Gate auction house is right here, with me.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pistache.3: The more you laugh, the lower the price. That's a secret. Don't tell anyone.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pluk.1: I have ten rubber ducks! Well, had. They floated off through the Canal Quarter.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pluk.2: If you fly over the water, you can catch them. With a carpet. Or with a really long arm.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_pluk.3: My favorite duck is called Quack. The others are called Quack too. That's easy.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rimpel.1: I live in the Pink Dunes. Every day my little house is in a different spot. The sand shifts.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rimpel.2: Queen Wormelina swims through the dunes. She used to sing. Now she only grumbles.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rimpel.3: The Dune Beacon stands on the highest dune. When it burns again, I'll be able to sleep again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_ringeling.1: Do I know you? Not yet, darling. Not yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_ringeling.2: What a lovely city. So... shared. I still have to get used to it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_ringeling.3: I have ten toes. That's normal. Ten bare toes. That's new.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosje.1: I'm the oldest guh in the gorge. I was here when these rocks were still blushing softly pink. They're still blushing now.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosje.2: The Treasure Room was carved from a single piece of rock. By my great-grandmother. With a teaspoon. It took a while.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosje.3: At night we always used to watch the star beacons. Now they're out. The gorge is so dark without them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosmarijn.1: The hanging gardens hang over the edges of the ledges. They like hanging. Sometimes I hang out with them.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosmarijn.2: Carrying water up is hard work. But a rose that thanks you makes it worth it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_roosmarijn.3: Watch out for the wall stairs. They're steep. And they count down out loud when you go down.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rozijntje.1: Welcome to my Hall of Mirrors, knight. Don't look in the mirrors too long. You'll start to like yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rozijntje.2: Saffron Gate lives on the water from the Mother Oasis. And on tea. Mostly on tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_rozijntje.3: A sultana has to be strict. I practice every morning. It's not working yet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_spetter.1: I deliver mail along the waterfalls. Fast and wet. Mostly wet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_spetter.2: With a carpet you're faster. With a carpet and an umbrella you're dry.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_spetter.3: I hold a record. I'm not telling which one. You'll have to try it yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stempel.1: Mail! Mail for the cliff houses! Everyone here lives at a different height. My paws are very strong.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stempel.2: I have a bag full of letters and a head full of stairs.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stempel.3: Sometimes I send a letter to myself. Then I get mail too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stof.1: I'm an archaeologist. I dig into old things. And into cookie tins. That's a kind of archaeology too.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stof.2: The Star Guhs built temples here for the stars. They counted every single one. One by one.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_stof.3: The Sunken Observatory lies in Ruin Valley. Half buried in sand. Don't go in alone.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_twinkel.1: The stars are maps that switch on at night. Whoever can read them never gets lost.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_twinkel.2: My telescope is made of copper. It's so big I need a little stepladder for it. And a cushion.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_twinkel.3: Five beacons. Five stars. Five times as dark as before. That's too much dark.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_1.1: We come from far away. From where all the roads go one way.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_1.2: There's water here. Sweet water. I didn't know water could be sweet.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_2.1: The Mikas said the oasis was empty. It's full! They lied.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_2.2: My little ones are finally asleep. By the water.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_2.3: Can I have another bowl? For later. For the journey.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_3.1: I walked the whole East Route. My feet are now officially flat.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_3.2: There's a gray tower near here. I don't look at it.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_vluchteling_3.3: Tomorrow I'm going to Saffron Gate. They say there's tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_1.1: Light the campfire: that's where you wake up if you faint. Even in the desert.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_1.2: We guard the road. With a lance, a lantern and a thermos of tea.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_wacht_1.3: In the daytime the sand is too hot for humpguh paws. That's why caravans travel at night.

vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_zandloper.1: Welcome to the Rose Gorge Skyport! From here you can look right into the gorge. Don't lean too far forward.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_zandloper.2: I count the ships with my hourglass. One ship per hourglass. Sometimes it tips over. Then I start counting again.
vadsrijk.npc.praat.z6_zandloper.3: Want to travel? Line E flies to Highchonk. And I have the travel map.
